author: ZudaR
message:
WL HAL: ADCEx Calibration: wait for ADRDY before writing factor, then ADDIS
Fixes an internal-error/disable-timeout seen with slow fADC (large prescaler).
Keeps HAL state machine and timeouts consistent; no API change.

Signed-off-by: ZudaR <d.zudin@alarmtrade.ru>
